purpose: Pins every claim the aletheia and cave-expedition repos make about each other. A count or id set changes in one repo only together with a reviewed edit to this file, so drift is a visible diff instead of silent. PENDING entries name the pull request that clears them and are removed in the same change that merges it.

cave.audit_ids_contiguous.description: AUDIT-xxx ids in cave verification/AUDIT_LOG.md form a contiguous range with no gaps and no duplicate ids.

aletheia.cites_known_audits.description: Every AUDIT-xxx id cited in aletheia README.md, THEORY.md and evidence/*.md exists in the cave AUDIT_LOG or is declared pending here with its tracking pull request.

pending.clears_when: cave-expedition#1 merges, so verification/AUDIT_LOG.md on main carries these rows; then delete this entry

cave.check_script_count_matches_citation.description: The number of verification/checks/check_*.py files in cave equals the number of verifier scripts aletheia cites.

pending.clears_when: cave-expedition#1 merges and adds check_013 and check_014, bringing cave main to 14 check scripts; then delete this entry

cave.n2_set_matches.description: The audits cave README labels N2 equal the set aletheia describes as N2 (plus the one it lists as borderline N1/N2).

pending.clears_when: cave-expedition#1 merges and adds AUDIT-020R to the cave ledger and README; then delete this entry

cave.seam_count_consistent.description: len(peer-web/frontier_seams.json) equals every seam count stated in peer-web/PEER_WEB.md.

cave.portal_count_consistent.description: len(cartography/entry_points.json) equals the number of portals in cartography/frontier_portals.md.

cave.readme_verified_claim_consistent.description: Cave README does not assert every track reached VERIFIED unless every FALSIFIED/PARTIAL ledger row has a closing row or the README carries an explicit caveat.

assertion_strings: Every active expedition track has reached `VERIFIED` status
Every active expedition track reached `VERIFIED` status

twin.license_verbatim.description: Both LICENSE files are byte-identical to each other and to the canonical Apache-2.0 text (SHA-256 pinned).

expected.note: The pinned hash is the text both open pull requests ship. The also-accepted hash is the byte form served at apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt, which differs only in the position of one blank line.

pending.clears_when: aletheia#14 merges and LICENSE is the verbatim Apache-2.0 text; then delete this entry
cave-expedition#11 merges and LICENSE is the verbatim Apache-2.0 text; then delete this entry

twin.ci_present.description: Each repo has a CI workflow that runs its own checks.

cave.clears_when: cave-expedition#12 merges and adds a workflow that runs verification/checks scripts; then set if_missing to DRIFT
